source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Topic 5.5.1.4 (PDF 147, printed 144).

blocks.text: Scatterplots do variables ka relationship (aapas ka taluq) dikhate hain. Har point (nuqta) ek observation (ek record ya ek naap) hai, aur graph par us ki jagah dono variables ki qeematein batati hai.
Misal: Scatterplot se dekha ja sakta hai ke parhai ke ghanton aur exam scores mein kya relationship hai.

blocks.alt: Scatterplot: x-axis par Hours 0 se 10 aur y-axis par scores 0 se 100. Terah points 0 ghante par taqreeban 40 se 8 ghante par taqreeban 95 tak oopar jate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.7: Parhai ke ghanton aur exam scores ka relationship dikhane wala scatterplot (kitab ki Figure 5.7 jaisa hamara apna diagram).

blocks.prompt: Points ka kaunsa pattern positive relationship (ek barhe to doosra bhi barhe) dikhata hai?
blocks.explanation: Neeche left se upar right ki taraf jaate points: ek variable barhe to doosra bhi barhta hai.

items: Scatterplot: har observation ka ek point; ghante aur marks jaise relationship dikhata hai.
